headlines.text: On this day in 2023, a new champion was crowned for the FTW Title as Jack Perry vs. Hook battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.44 ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. Burying his "Jungle Boy" persona in the desert and switching his entrance to Beethoven's Symphony No. 5, Jack Perry ended Hook's undefeated streak with a title-belt shot behind the referee's back to become FTW Champion.
Back on this day in 2024, it was Cassidy, Ishii & O'Reilly's first night in AEW as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.48.
That Saturday in 2025, it marked the first-ever meeting between Rush and Katsuyori Shibata on Collision, rated 7.17 ? a well-worked match.

secondaries.text: Looking back to 2023, when Kota Ibushi wasted no time making an impression, debuting right in the main event in a Blood And Guts match against Castagnoli, Moxley & Yuta vs. The Young Bucks vs. Adam Page vs. Kenny Omega vs. Matt Jackson vs. Nick Jackson vs. Claudio Castagnoli vs. Jon Moxley vs. Wheeler Yuta vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. PAC, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.16 ? a fantastic contest. PAC dropped out mid-match by flipping off his own partners and walking away, while Don Callis pulled Takeshita from the cage entirely, as the returning Kota Ibushi helped The Golden Elite outlast the Blackpool Combat Club.
Flash back to 2023, when Cole & MJF vs. Garcia & Guevara met in a Tournament Final on Dynamite, rated 7.47 ? a solid showing ? part of a stacked Blood and Guts '23 card, rated 8.38 overall.

2025 brought us this moment: JetSpeed & Dorada vs. JetSpeed vs. Bandido vs. Kevin Knight vs. Mike Bailey vs. Mascara Dorada vs. Hechicero vs. Josh Alexander vs. Lance Archer vs. Rocky Romero closed out Collision, rated 7.52 ? a match that delivered.
